sample_unit: patient cases (20 in clinical trial, 15 in routine care)
models_evaluated: Treatment recommender CDSS (machine-learning model for rifampicin-resistant TB regimens)

links.outcome: Physician acceptance of AI treatment recommendations in routine care, and reasons for rejection
links.effect: Physicians rejected the treatment recommendation in 7 of 15 routine-care cases because it deviated from national TB treatment guidelines.
links.quote: In routine care setting, physicians rejected the treatment recommendation in 7 out of 15 cases because it deviated from the national TB treatment guidelines.

screen.reason: The study deployed and evaluated a machine learning clinical decision support system for individualized tuberculosis treatment recommendations in both a clinical trial and routine care setting, tracking clinician acceptance and usability.
